verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe central spend monitoring across providers, with spend and model usage logged per request. The Requests view summarizes activity by project and API key, logs can be filtered by model and provider and exported, and budgets can be set per team, project, API key, or team member. Together these cover the core of tracking spend by model, key, and team in one place. Missing for 10: explicit per-user spend reporting (only implied by per-member budgets), an explicit per-model spend breakdown view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
